messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the motion reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still in profile, then turns around to face the camera while adjusting the front of the sweater.","camera":"A static, low-angle medium shot that keeps the person centered in the frame.","clothing":"A yellow long-sleeved sweater with a brown patterned design, blue jeans, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Dark hair with a reddish tint visible on the top of the head.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small topknot or bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A young person with a slim build and light skin, shown in profile and then turning toward the camera.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or fairground at dusk, featuring a large wooden pavilion with rows of white lights, a red and blue striped food stand, and a sandy ground with footprints."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's action changed from walking and touching their head to standing and turning while bringing a hand toward the chest in a more contemplative pose. The original amusement-park scene, clothing, character appearance, lighting, and static low-angle framing were largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose as shown in the motion reference, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the final pose closely matches the specific thoughtful pose demonstrated in the reference video.
unexpected_changes: The output action includes a noticeable turn toward the camera and sweater adjustment, which is not clearly the same as the reference's subtle standing thoughtfulness.
